limitations: This is a task-local prototype, not a production parametric API or approval.
Evidence covers only the retained seeds, generated inputs, and two rank settings.
The farthest setting changes only candidate selection; component extraction and the move/cut/grow transformation stay fixed.
Rival checks cover nearest versus farthest, not every possible candidate-ranking policy.

input_constraints: lawful selected-generator scenes with at least two qualifying candidates
nearest and farthest settings produce different outputs
invariant_reasoning: identify the modal background and same-color connected objects
enumerate mover/wall pairs satisfying facing and span constraints
rank candidates by gap according to the episode parameter
move the selected mover through the wall, cut its channel, and widen the wall
parameter_contract.name: candidate_rank

farthest.text:
(rule!
 ;; A small MOVER faces a wider solid WALL (farthest such pair wins,
 ;; bigger wall on ties). The mover teleports through: a doorway its
 ;; own width is cut through the wall, the wall grows sideways by half
 ;; the mover's size (at least 1), and the mover reappears flush on the
 ;; far side (or tucked inside when the wall hugs the grid edge).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg
       (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                    (at g r c))))
     (define objs (objects g bg))
     (define (overlap? a1 a2 b1 b2) (and (<= a1 b2) (<= b1 a2)))
     (define (put gg r c v)
       (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
     (define candidates  ;; (gap wall-size dir mover wall)
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (for*/list ((m objs) (t objs) #:when (not (eq? m t)))
                 (and (solid-rect? t)
                      (cond ((and (> (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 m))
                                  (overlap? (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 m)
                                            (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (> (obj-w t) (obj-w m)))
                             (list (- (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 m) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'down m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (overlap? (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 m)
                                            (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (> (obj-w t) (obj-w m)))
                             (list (- (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 t) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'up m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 m))
                                  (overlap? (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 m)
                                            (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (> (obj-h t) (obj-h m)))
                             (list (- (obj-c1 t) (obj-c2 m) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'right m t))
                            ((and (> (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 t))
                                  (overlap? (obj-r1 m) (obj-r2 m)
                                            (obj-r1 t) (obj-r2 t))
                                  (> (obj-h t) (obj-h m)))
                             (list (- (obj-c1 m) (obj-c2 t) 1)
                                   (obj-size t) 'left m t))
                            (else #f))))))
     (define ranked
       (sort candidates
             (lambda (a b) (cond ((> (first a) (first b)) #t)
                                 ((< (first a) (first b)) #f)
                                 (else (> (second a) (second b)))))))
     (if (null? ranked)
         g
         (let* ((cand (first ranked))
                (dir (third cand))
                (m (fourth cand))
                (t (fifth cand))
                (m-cells (map (lambda (p)
                                (list (first p) (second p)
                                      (at g (first p) (second p))))
                              (obj-cells m)))
                (pad-v (max 1 (quotient (obj-w m) 2)))
                (pad-h (max 1 (quotient (obj-h m) 2)))
                (cleared (paint-cells g (obj-cells m) bg))
                (paint-mover
                 (lambda (gg dr dc)
                   (for/fold ((out gg)) ((cv m-cells))
                     (put out (+ dr (- (first cv) (obj-r1 m)))
                          (+ dc (- (second cv) (obj-c1 m)))
                          (third cv))))))
           (if (member? dir (list 'down 'up))
               (let* ((cut  ;; doorway through the wall, mover-wide
                       (for*/fold ((out cleared))
                                  ((r (range (obj-r1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))
                                   (c (range (obj-c1 m)
                                             (+ (obj-c2 m) 1))))
                         (put out r c bg)))
                      (grown  ;; wall widens by pad-v on both flanks
                       (for*/fold ((out cut))
                                  ((r (range (obj-r1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))
                                   (d (range 1 (+ pad-v 1))))
                         (put (put out r (- (obj-c1 t) d)
                                   (obj-color t))
                              r (+ (obj-c2 t) d) (obj-color t))))
                      (dest-r (if (eq? dir 'up)
                                  (max 0 (- (obj-r1 t) (obj-h m)))
                                  (if (= (obj-r2 t) (- h 1))
                                      (+ (- (obj-r2 t) (obj-h m)) 1)
                                      (+ (obj-r2 t) 1)))))
                 (paint-mover grown dest-r (obj-c1 m)))
               (let* ((cut
                       (for*/fold ((out cleared))
                                  ((r (range (obj-r1 m)
                                             (+ (obj-r2 m) 1)))
                                   (c (range (obj-c1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-c2 t) 1))))
                         (put out r c bg)))
                      (grown
                       (for*/fold ((out cut))
                                  ((c (range (obj-c1 t)
                                             (+ (obj-c2 t) 1)))
                                   (d (range 1 (+ pad-h 1))))
                         (put (put out (- (obj-r1 t) d) c
                                   (obj-color t))
                              (+ (obj-r2 t) d) c (obj-color t))))
                      (dest-c (if (eq? dir 'left)
                                  (max 0 (- (obj-c1 t) (obj-w m)))
                                  (if (= (obj-c2 t) (- w 1))
                                      (+ (- (obj-c2 t) (obj-w m)) 1)
                                      (+ (obj-c2 t) 1)))))
                 (paint-mover grown (obj-r1 m) dest-c))))))))
